meta.name: Cut Sheet
meta.notes: Primary drives the cutting head, cut lines, stamps, buttons and live-map glow (lifted toward white via color-mix so navy/near-black stay visible on graphite); accent tints eyebrows and tags.

issues: Offcuts gallery renders as a row of blank white cards: lazy images inside the horizontal scroller never load in stills, and the #e8eef0 fallback looks like broken content
Nest plan collapses with a short category list: Brinks has 1 category, so one small shape sits on a huge empty glass sheet
Story 'screen' for TeleQare shows an empty hatch: the transparent PNG has dark content on a dark plate, so it's invisible
Hero machine display sits at DEPTH 0.00 / TORQUE 0.0 between cuts, so the 'QR-set readouts' look dead in every screenshot
Library strip with a single stat leaves the right side empty (minor)
Typography is strong (Anybody wide + Kode Mono) and the cut-out signature works; layout rhythm drops off after the products
fixed: Offcuts turned into numbered glass plates (OFC-01…): eager-loaded, object-fit contain on a light sheen plate, so product PNGs and photos both read and nothing shows as a blank card

Added 'uncut stock' ghost shapes to the nest plan: ghost k mirrors slot k's footprint and only appears when that category is missing (CSS :has), so 1–4 categories still fill the sheet as a believable nesting plan, with responsive spans
Screen images get a light glass backing and load eagerly in the story, so transparent PNGs become visible
Hero readouts hold the set values (0.33 mm / 2.4 Nm) between cuts instead of resetting to zero
